use_case_summary: Primary workloads: large-scale document search (vector embeddings + reranking) and an in-product chat assistant for enterprise customers. SLOs: p95 <= 120ms for single-vector embed calls, p95 <= 250ms for end-to-end chat turns at steady-state 100 RPS. High read throughput during business hours, burst to 500 RPS tolerated if Dedicated burst capacity available. Model preference: open models with redwood-verified profiles; fallback to smaller quantized variants for cost/latency tradeoffs. Routing: region-aware, failover to secondary region in NA. Data residency: selected customers' content must remain in their VPC/on-prem deployment for compliance.
